steps: Stir the ragi flour into about 100 ml cold water until there are no lumps.
Cook on low heat, stirring all the time, for 4 to 5 minutes until thick and glossy.
Pour in the milk and cook 2 more minutes, still stirring.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the banana and ghee.
Let it cool until just warm; it thickens as it cools.
note: Milk is added because the child is past one year; one source keeps it out before then. No jaggery: the ripe banana is the only sweetness.
